capitals.name: Dangchang City (west of Tanchang County, Gansu)

ledger.x: 424: the Dangchang Qiang kingdom's first dated record.

wars.name: Dangchang raids on Wei and Zhou
wars.outcome: 'In the 6th century, as the Northern Wei collapsed and split into two', Dangchang allied with the Tuyuhun and attacked the Northern Wei and then the Western Wei; Liang Miding's raids in 564 brought the Northern Zhou campaign that ended the kingdom.

certainty.note: A mountain kingdom described by one line of area; no frontier on any page.
